hp_model: Continuous numeric internal HP; visual stages do not quantize HP or damage.
fraction: Clamp current_hp / max_hp to [0, 1]; max_hp must be positive.
boss_bar: Continuous vertical meter in dedicated right sidebar; centered entrance artwork supplies name

hit_feedback.status: Integration specification, not implemented by this artwork delivery
hit_feedback.trigger: Every successful damage event, even when the stage does not change
hit_feedback.behavior: Brief pale warm sprite flash plus local impact particles; preserve current damage row. Restart on each hit.
hit_feedback.flushfiend: Use same-row hit recoil frame briefly; do not reset to healthy artwork.
hit_feedback.widow: Keep current wingbeat frame and damaged feather/halo silhouette during flash.
hit_feedback.rapid_fire: Ensure flash ends before the next normal Tony shot; do not require crossing a threshold.

boss_hud.requirement_status: Sean selected right-side option B; normal player HUD retained
boss_hud.implementation_status: Prototype95: selected centered entrance titles and vertical meters integrated; live visual review pending
boss_hud.name_position: Centered entrance title only; no persistent sidebar name
boss_hud.layout: Normal82px player HUD stays unscaled. Entire boss world uniformly scaled0.9 with offset0,54 into864x486, right96px dedicated sidebar; combat geometry/camera unchanged.
boss_hud.visible_during: Entire active boss encounter, including closed/invulnerable phases
boss_hud.fill: Remaining health anchored at bottom; top edge descends immediately with actual HP, with brief damage trail
boss_hud.style: Heavy industrial frame, dark empty track, green/yellow/red health fill; centered entrance name and visible accumulated empty space.
boss_hud.numbers: Exact HP and damage remain development-only by default
boss_hud.death: Reach empty immediately at zero HP; retain empty bar for one second, then fade out.
boss_hud.reset: Hide on leaving encounter; reset fill and trail from boss HP on retry.

fill_colors.source: Clamped actual current_hp / max_hp, independent of trailing damage fill and attack phases
fill_colors.transition: Switch immediately at thresholds; no flashing
fill_colors.zero_hp: No colored fill; retain empty track during death hold
fill_colors.accessibility: Remaining bar length always communicates health independently of color

cockroach-swarm.style: Living Swarm, selected by Sean on October 19, 2026
cockroach-swarm.fill: Authored orange texture at every positive HP; dark depleted track; cockroach frame
cockroach-swarm.fill_behavior: Crop vertically from top with HP; bottom remains anchored; preserve trail and death fade
cockroach-swarm.status: Vertical Living Swarm skin integrated in Prototype94; orange fill retained

presentation.hold: Through Skitterling death/exit until room release and through Clogfather portal completion; reset on retry/new game.
